summary: This bill allows retired or 100% disabled members of the uniformed services to continue contributing to the Thrift Savings Plan after separation, provided they had an account before leaving service.

scores.thoughts: This bill allows certain retired or disabled uniformed service members to continue contributing their own pay or compensation to the Thrift Savings Plan. It explicitly states that no contributions shall be made for their benefit under section 8432, which typically covers agency contributions. Therefore, the bill does not increase government spending; it merely expands eligibility for personal contributions to a retirement savings plan.
